text:
A scientist describes light as being monochromatic.
What does this tell you about the light?
A
It has a single frequency.
B
It has more than one wavelength.
C
It travels at a single speed in a single direction.
D
It travels at different speeds in different directions.

options.label: B
options.text: It has more than one wavelength.

options.label: C
options.text: It travels at a single speed in a single direction.

options.label: D
options.text: It travels at different speeds in different directions.
